description: A change small enough to review in minutes and revert without regret, checked by tests before the next one starts.
A failing test is the agent's goal: it iterates against the test runner while you review the test and the implementation.
An extra working directory on its own branch from the same repository, so parallel agents never share files.
Line-by-line review for authentication, payments and migrations; lighter review where mistakes are cheap and tests cover them.
The gap between the code a team ships and the code it understands. It feels like speed until an incident needs someone who knows the code.
Ask the agent to explore and propose a plan before editing; correcting a plan is cheaper than correcting code.
